newsitem.title: CHINA: Enron to develop oil, gas in SW China.
newsitem.headline: Enron to develop oil, gas in SW China.

text.p: Enron Oil & Gas has signed a production sharing agreement with China National Petroleum Corp to develop oil reserves in southwestern Sichuan province, the China Daily said on Tuesday.
The contract, signed on Monday, involves the Chuanzhong block in one of China's oldest producing areas, covers 7,500 square km and is believed to have abundant oil and gas reserves, it said.
However, the size and geology of the block make exploration and exploitation difficult, it said, without giving details.

Under the contract, Enron Oil & Gas China (Sichuan) Ltd will be the developer and will finish all pilot drilling in the two years of initial study, shouldering all exploration and investment risks, it said.
Enron will share its advanced technology with the Chinese side, it said.
